segments.thag7.3:1.1: “Ekaputto ahaṃ āsiṃ, piyo mātu piyo pitu;
segments.thag7.3:2.3: Ubho pitā ca mātā ca, buddhassa upanāmayuṃ”.
segments.thag7.3:3.3: Imaṃ dadāma te nātha, jinassa paricārakaṃ”.
segments.thag7.3:5.3: Anoggatasmiṃ sūriyasmiṃ, tato cittaṃ vimucci me.
segments.thag7.3:6.3: ‘Ehi bhaddā’ti maṃ āha, sā me āsūpasampadā.
